questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Accounting Equation. if assets are ₹5,00,000 and liabilities are ₹1,80,000, capital equals:
questions.subject: Accountancy

questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Journal. a credit purchase of goods is recorded by:

options.A: Purchases A/c Dr. To Supplier A/c
options.B: Supplier A/c Dr. To Purchases A/c
options.C: Cash A/c Dr. To Sales A/c
options.D: Sales A/c Dr. To Cash A/c

questions.explanation: Purchases are debited and the supplier is credited for a credit purchase.
questions.subject: Accountancy

questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Depreciation. depreciation is charged to:

options.A: Allocate depreciable cost over useful life

questions.explanation: Depreciation systematically allocates an asset’s depreciable amount over useful life.
questions.subject: Accountancy

questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Bank Reconciliation. an unpresented cheque issued by the business usually causes the bank statement balance to be:

options.A: Higher than the cash book balance
options.B: Lower than the cash book balance

questions.explanation: The cash book is reduced when issued; the bank has not yet recorded the payment.
questions.subject: Accountancy

questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Trial Balance. a trial balance is prepared mainly to check:

options.A: Arithmetical equality of debit and credit balances

questions.explanation: A trial balance checks the equality of ledger debit and credit totals, though it cannot detect every error.
questions.subject: Accountancy

questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Inventory. under FIFO, issues are priced using:
questions.explanation: FIFO assumes the earliest acquired units are issued first.
questions.subject: Accountancy

questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Financial Statements. outstanding salary at year-end is treated as:
questions.explanation: Outstanding salary is an accrued expense and a liability.
questions.subject: Accountancy

questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Rectification. a suspense account may be opened when:

options.A: Trial balance totals disagree and the difference is temporarily placed

questions.explanation: A suspense account temporarily records an unexplained difference pending correction.
questions.subject: Accountancy

questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Partnership. in the absence of an agreement, partners share profits:
questions.explanation: The Partnership Act default is equal sharing of profits and losses.
questions.subject: Accountancy

questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Cash Flow. purchase of machinery for cash is classified as:
questions.explanation: Acquisition of a long-term asset is an investing cash flow.
questions.subject: Accountancy

questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Ratio Analysis. current ratio is calculated as:
questions.explanation: The current ratio measures short-term liquidity using current assets and liabilities.
questions.subject: Accountancy

questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Company Accounts. securities premium is generally shown under:
questions.explanation: Securities premium is a capital reserve presented within equity.
questions.subject: Accountancy

questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Not-for-Profit. subscription received in advance is:
questions.explanation: Advance subscription relates to a future period and is a liability at year-end.
questions.subject: Accountancy

questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Partnership. goodwill is an intangible asset representing:
questions.explanation: Goodwill reflects benefits from reputation, customer relationships and expected excess earnings.
questions.subject: Accountancy

questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Financial Statements. a provision for doubtful debts is created to:

options.A: Recognise expected credit losses on receivables

questions.explanation: The provision recognises the estimated portion of receivables that may not be collected.
questions.subject: Accountancy
